heroHeadline: Day 794: Gunmen Storm Tai Pak Restaurant in Culiacán, Wounding Singer Víctor Valverde, as 'La Chapiza' Banners Accuse Security Commanders of Colluding with La Mayiza
heroSubtitle: 794 days of cartel civil war: on September 24, gunmen stormed the Tai Pak restaurant in Culiacán's Tres Ríos development, killing one man and wounding six others including 21-year-old regional Mexican singer Víctor Valverde, while a separate shooting killed a man near the city's Civil Cemetery and a handcuffed man was found executed beside the municipal landfill in the Bicentenario neighborhood. The same morning, banners signed by 'La Chapiza' appeared across Mazatlán, Rosario and Concordia accusing named Army and State Preventive Police commanders of colluding with La Mayiza, prompting FGE and FGR investigations. It follows a September 23 run in which gunmen shot up three homes and vehicles in Culiacán's Josefa Ortiz de Domínguez neighborhood, wounding a woman, and a man was killed in Mazatlán's Flores Magón neighborhood. Noroeste's cumulative tally rose to 3,892 violent deaths, 4,424 kidnappings and 12,570 vehicle thefts since September 9, 2024. Days of open civil war: 794+.
